value.answer: Tomorrow looks showery and warm in Toronto. High around 24°C, with a 60% chance of showers and a risk of thunderstorms in the morning and afternoon, maybe 10 to 20 mm of rain. It'll be windy too, southwest around 20 km/h with gusts to 40 near noon. Bring an umbrella.
